title: TD3: Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods
description: DDPG suffers from overestimation of Q-values due to function approximation error, causing the policy to exploit incorrect high-value actions. TD3 adds three fixes: clipped double Q-learning (take min of two Q-networks), delayed policy updates (update actor less frequently than critic), and target policy smoothing (add noise to target actions). Standard baseline for continuous control.
